Pan-Seared Pork Chops with Jammy Zwetsch.title: Schweinekotelett with Zwetschgen, mustard and buttered Spätzle
Pan-Seared Pork Chops with Jammy Zwetsch.pitch: Plums collapsed right in the pan juices with coarse mustard and fresh thyme. Rich, sweet-tart pan sauce over tender, butter-tossed Spätzle.

Pan-Seared Pork Chops with Jammy Zwetsch.title: Pork chops with balsamic plums, crisp sage and soft polenta
Pan-Seared Pork Chops with Jammy Zwetsch.pitch: Fresh sage leaves crackled in foaming butter, plums caramelized with a splash of balsamic into a glossy glaze. Spooned over warm, creamy polenta.

Pan-Seared Pork Chops with Jammy Zwetsch.title: Cantonese plum-glazed chops with ginger and Shaoxing wine
Pan-Seared Pork Chops with Jammy Zwetsch.pitch: Chops seared hard, then deglazed with Shaoxing wine and simmered in plums, soy, and fresh ginger until glossy and sticky. Steamed jasmine rice to soak it up.

Pan-Seared Pork Chops with Jammy Zwetsch.title: Chuletas con ciruela: pork chops with smoky chipotle plum glaze
Pan-Seared Pork Chops with Jammy Zwetsch.pitch: Plums melted down in the pan with chipotle in adobo, a pinch of Mexican oregano, and fresh lime. Sweet, smoky heat clinging to the chops, warm corn tortillas on the side.

Late-Summer Charred Sweet Corn, Zucchini.title: Calabacitas con elote: charred corn and zucchini skillet
Late-Summer Charred Sweet Corn, Zucchini.pitch: Corn charred hard in a hot skillet with diced zucchini and jalapeño, finished off the heat with crumbled salty cheese, fresh lime, and warm corn tortillas.

Late-Summer Charred Sweet Corn, Zucchini.title: Charred corn and zucchini skillet with warm feta and mint
Late-Summer Charred Sweet Corn, Zucchini.pitch: Zucchini coins and sweet corn blistered in olive oil, then tossed off the heat with crumbled feta, torn fresh mint, and lemon juice. Crusty bread to scoop it up.

Late-Summer Charred Sweet Corn, Zucchini.title: Charred corn and zucchini over cold garlic labneh with pul biber
Late-Summer Charred Sweet Corn, Zucchini.pitch: Smoky blistered corn and zucchini spooned hot over cool, thick garlic labneh, drizzled with foaming pul biber butter. Warm flatbread for dipping.

Late-Summer Charred Sweet Corn, Zucchini.title: Blistered corn and zucchini with sweet basil and shaved pecorino
Late-Summer Charred Sweet Corn, Zucchini.pitch: Zucchini and sweet corn charred fast in olive oil with garlic, tossed off the heat with fresh basil and sharp, salty pecorino. Crusty bread to catch the pan juices.

Brown-Butter Pfifferlinge (Chanterelles).title: Pan-fried chanterelles with Schmand and parsley on sourdough toast
Brown-Butter Pfifferlinge (Chanterelles).pitch: Chanterelles seared fast in foaming butter with minced shallot, finished with a spoonful of tangy Schmand and fresh parsley. Piled hot onto thick, crusty sourdough.

Brown-Butter Pfifferlinge (Chanterelles).title: Bistro chanterelles with garlic, thyme and a runny fried egg on toast
Brown-Butter Pfifferlinge (Chanterelles).pitch: Chanterelles sautéed hot in butter with crushed garlic and thyme, piled onto grilled sourdough with a runny-yolk fried egg to enrich every bite.

Brown-Butter Pfifferlinge (Chanterelles).title: Chanterelles with crispy serrano ham and sherry vinegar on toast
Brown-Butter Pfifferlinge (Chanterelles).pitch: Chanterelles tossed in olive oil with crisp bits of serrano ham and garlic, finished with a splash of sherry vinegar to cut the richness. Spooned over toasted bread.

Brown-Butter Pfifferlinge (Chanterelles).title: Swedish kantarellmacka with dill and butter-fried sourdough
Brown-Butter Pfifferlinge (Chanterelles).pitch: Chanterelles browned in generous butter with shallots and a splash of cream, tossed with fresh dill. Spooned over thick sourdough fried golden right in the pan drippings.

Sheet-Pan Roasted Sausage, Sweet Bell Pe.title: Salsiccia traybake with sweet peppers, crisp potatoes and rosemary
Sheet-Pan Roasted Sausage, Sweet Bell Pe.pitch: Fennel salsiccia, baby potatoes and sweet peppers roasted hot on one tray with rosemary and whole garlic. The potatoes crisp in the sausage drippings while the peppers turn sweet and jammy.

Sheet-Pan Roasted Sausage, Sweet Bell Pe.title: Roasted chorizo and potatoes with sweet peppers and sherry vinegar
Sheet-Pan Roasted Sausage, Sweet Bell Pe.pitch: Fresh cooking chorizo, sweet peppers and baby potatoes roasted until sizzling in spiced red oil. A splash of sherry vinegar over the hot tray cuts the rich fat.

Sheet-Pan Roasted Sausage, Sweet Bell Pe.title: Spicy merguez traybake with sweet peppers and roasted cumin
Sheet-Pan Roasted Sausage, Sweet Bell Pe.pitch: Spicy lamb merguez and baby potatoes roasted with sweet peppers and cumin seeds until browned and crisp. Squeeze fresh lemon over the sizzling tray.

Sheet-Pan Roasted Sausage, Sweet Bell Pe.title: Roasted bratwurst and crispy potatoes with caraway and sweet peppers
Sheet-Pan Roasted Sausage, Sweet Bell Pe.pitch: Coarse bratwurst, sweet peppers and new potatoes roasted with crushed caraway until browned and crisp. Served with a big spoonful of sharp mustard on the side.

Jammy Cherry Tomato & Ricotta Pasta.title: Rigatoni with burst cherry tomatoes, fresh ricotta and basil
Jammy Cherry Tomato & Ricotta Pasta.pitch: Cherry tomatoes blistered in olive oil with garlic until jammy, tossed with al dente rigatoni, then swirled off heat with fresh ricotta and basil into a velvety pink sauce.

Jammy Cherry Tomato & Ricotta Pasta.title: Rigatoni with jammy cherry tomatoes, spicy 'nduja and torn burrata
Jammy Cherry Tomato & Ricotta Pasta.pitch: Cherry tomatoes cooked down with a spoonful of fiery 'nduja into a sweet, spicy pan sauce. Tossed with pasta and topped with cool, creamy burrata that melts in ribbons as you eat.

Jammy Cherry Tomato & Ricotta Pasta.title: Rigatoni with blistered tomatoes, briny capers and ricotta salata
Jammy Cherry Tomato & Ricotta Pasta.pitch: Sweet cherry tomatoes blistered with garlic and briny capers, tossed with rigatoni and finished with a mountain of shaved salty ricotta salata and fresh basil.

Jammy Cherry Tomato & Ricotta Pasta.title: Pasta allo scarpariello: cherry tomatoes with pecorino and parmesan
Jammy Cherry Tomato & Ricotta Pasta.pitch: Cherry tomatoes collapsed with garlic and chili, then beaten vigorously off heat with pecorino, parmesan, and pasta water until the cheese melts into a glossy, clinging red glaze.

Flammkuchen with Schmand, bacon and onio.title: Classic Alsatian tarte flambée with bacon and sweet onions
Flammkuchen with Schmand, bacon and onio.pitch: Paper-thin dough spread with Schmand, scattered with smoked bacon lardons and thinly sliced sweet onions. Baked blistering hot until cracker-crisp.

Flammkuchen with Schmand, bacon and onio.title: Tarte flambée gratinée with smoked bacon, onions and bubbling Gruyère
Flammkuchen with Schmand, bacon and onio.pitch: The classic bacon and onion base topped with grated Gruyère that melts into rich, golden, bubbling pockets at maximum oven heat.

Flammkuchen with Schmand, bacon and onio.title: Crisp Flammkuchen with goat cheese, sliced apples and rosemary honey
Flammkuchen with Schmand, bacon and onio.pitch: Thin crust spread with Schmand, topped with tart apple slices, red onions and soft goat cheese. Drizzled with warm rosemary honey as soon as it blisters.

Flammkuchen with Schmand, bacon and onio.title: Crisp Flammkuchen with smoked salmon, red onions and fresh dill
Flammkuchen with Schmand, bacon and onio.pitch: Paper-thin crust baked with Schmand and shaved red onion, topped hot out of the oven with silky smoked salmon, fresh dill, and lemon.

Classic Spaghetti Cacio e Pepe.title: Classic Roman spaghetti cacio e pepe
Classic Spaghetti Cacio e Pepe.pitch: Coarsely crushed black peppercorns bloomed in the pan, tossed with spaghetti and finely grated Pecorino Romano into a silky, emulsified cheese sauce.

Classic Spaghetti Cacio e Pepe.title: Spaghetti alla gricia: cacio e pepe with crispy guanciale
Classic Spaghetti Cacio e Pepe.pitch: Rendered guanciale fat blooms the black pepper, tossed with al dente spaghetti, crispy pork bites, and a mountain of pecorino into a glossy sauce.

Classic Spaghetti Cacio e Pepe.title: Roman cacio e pepe with pan-crisped artichokes
Classic Spaghetti Cacio e Pepe.pitch: Thinly sliced artichoke hearts seared until golden and crisp, spooned over spaghetti coated in a sharp, peppery pecorino emulsion.

Classic Spaghetti Cacio e Pepe.title: Spaghetti cacio e pepe with toasted walnuts
Classic Spaghetti Cacio e Pepe.pitch: Silky pecorino and black pepper pasta finished with roughly crushed toasted walnuts for a warm, buttery crunch against the sharp cheese.

Spanish Tortilla de Patatas.title: The 15-minute tapas spread: potato-chip tortilla with pan con tomate and peppers
Spanish Tortilla de Patatas.pitch: The iconic Spanish bar hack: kettle chips soaked in egg for an instant custardy tortilla, served with blistered padrón peppers and tomato-rubbed crusty bread.

Spanish Tortilla de Patatas.title: Classic Spanish tortilla de patatas con cebolla with crisp green salad
Spanish Tortilla de Patatas.pitch: Thinly shaved potatoes and sweet onions slow-poached in olive oil until custardy, paired with a sharp sherry-vinaigrette green salad to cut the rich oil.

Spanish Tortilla de Patatas.title: Tortilla paisana with smoky cooking chorizo and sweet peppers
Spanish Tortilla de Patatas.pitch: Potatoes poached with diced cooking chorizo and sweet peppers, tinting the eggs with smoky paprika oil for a hearty, all-in-one skillet dinner.

Pasta all’Amatriciana.title: Classic bucatini all'amatriciana with crispy guanciale
Pasta all’Amatriciana.pitch: Guanciale crisped until golden, simmered with sweet San Marzano tomatoes and dried chili into a rich, porky sauce clinging to hollow bucatini, finished with sharp pecorino.

Pasta all’Amatriciana.title: Calabrian amatriciana with spicy 'nduja and smoked scamorza
Pasta all’Amatriciana.pitch: Crisped pancetta and fiery 'nduja cooked down in sweet cherry tomatoes, tossed with rigatoni and pockets of melting smoked cheese.

Pasta all’Amatriciana.title: Spanish macarrones con chorizo in rich tomato sofrito
Pasta all’Amatriciana.pitch: Diced cooking chorizo sizzled until it releases rich red oil, simmered with crushed tomatoes and garlic, tossed with pasta and aged manchego.
